decisions.statement: Each page named takes a value of its own.
A value is put in as the caller spells it rather than as text to quote.
A page stating the key already is refused rather than gaining a second value.
A page named twice is refused, because one page takes one value.
One page refused refuses the whole change.
A refusal over a page names that page.
An `after` the caller states places the key on every page named.
Nothing here reads what the value means.

definition: one value put under one key on each page named
